raw_text: Poonch ceasefire violation: Indian Army sources confirm six hours of intermittent shelling along the LoC in Jammu's Poonch sector early Thursday morning. Pakistan Army used small arms and 82mm mortars targeting Indian forward posts in Shahpur, Kirni, and Balakote sub-sectors. Indian troops retaliated effectively. District administration ordered precautionary evacuation of three border villages. No Indian casualties reported so far.
clean_text: Indian Army confirms six-hour ceasefire violation in Poonch. Pakistan used small arms and 82mm mortars. Three border villages evacuated. No Indian casualties reported.
